title: Love this app but
body:
Have been using this app a lot but can we have a little more love put into the front end please? It has changed my life but I just it felt a little bit better to use! There are bugs like tasks notifications that keep happening even after the routine was canceled. 
I would love an widget for the Apple Watch. 
Or the most basic things like the screen rotating when you put the phone in landscape mode. 
This app is life changing but just keep wishing it had more updates
author: Atmika Atmana
